propositions: Every reconcile pass re-attempts the identical set of inbound link writes that cannot succeed due to closed source, redundant ancestry, or cycle creation, without recording failures across passes.
The applier lacks durable memory of permanently impossible link ADDs; a failed write is logged as a warning and immediately forgotten, causing the same failure to re-occur on the next pass.

Inbound link failures due to deterministic structural verdicts (not transient I/O faults) must be classified, stored with a deciding digest, and skipped on subsequent passes until their structural inputs change.

The impossible links record must survive process restarts by committing to the tickets branch as a separate JSON file, and must be invalidated when structural changes occur to endpoints or intermediate nodes in the dependency graph.
